findings.current: The storm is almost upon us, and we’ll have to bring all our strength to bear against one another.
findings.defect: “Against one another” makes the assembled allies sound as though they will fight each other, rather than the opposing side.
findings.rationale: 서로 refers to the sides about to clash; it does not turn the conspirators against one another.
findings.replacement: The storm is almost upon us, and both sides will have to throw everything they have into the clash.
findings.source: 폭풍은 이미 코앞까지 다가왔고, 서로가 가진 모든 힘을 꺼내어 부딪쳐야 할 겁니다.

findings.current: The child who had left for the frontier, bundled in swaddling clothes, had returned as a proper young man.
findings.defect: “Young man” ages the returning child beyond the source’s 소년.
findings.rationale: The contrast is between an infant in swaddling clothes and a boy, not an adult.
findings.replacement: The child who had left for the frontier, bundled in swaddling clothes, had returned as a boy.
findings.source: 강보에 싸여 변방으로 떠났던 어린아이는 어엿한 소년이 되어 돌아왔으며

findings.defect: The repeated “I” reads as a stammer and loses the speaker’s deliberate correction from a less respectful form to a respectful one.
findings.rationale: 내가, 아니 제가 explicitly marks a self-correction in register after Ma Sanbao’s threatening look.

findings.current: Though more than a dozen people had gathered in one place
findings.defect: “More than a dozen” excludes eleven or twelve people, both possible under 십여 명.
findings.rationale: 십여 명 gives an approximate count just over ten.
findings.replacement: Though a dozen or so people had gathered in one place

findings.current: Their specialty was searching every corner as thoroughly as lice in a dog’s fur.
findings.defect: The simile makes lice sound like the searchers. The Guard searches as meticulously as someone picking out lice.
findings.rationale: 이 잡듯이 describes the manner of the Guard’s search, not the behavior of lice.
findings.replacement: Their specialty was combing every corner as if hunting for lice.
findings.source: 사방을 이 잡듯이 뒤지는 것이 특기였다.

findings.current: “Rumors about the Emperor never stop. It’s hard to guess what he’s planning.”
findings.defect: “Rumors” loses the disreputable, scandalous character of 추문 and blurs these reports with the earlier rumors they deliberately spread.
findings.rationale: 추문 specifically denotes scandalous reports about the Emperor.
findings.replacement: “Scandalous stories about the Emperor keep surfacing everywhere. It’s hard to guess what he’s planning.”
findings.source: “사방에서 황제에 대한 추문(醜聞)이 끊이지 않고 있습니다. 그의 의도가 뭔지 짐작하기 어렵군요.”

summary: Several passages alter a quantity, the returned child’s age, or who is expected to fight. Other findings concern a surveillance image and a lost shift in register.
